description: Project-authored technical checks shared by SUMMA and mizuRoute. The fixture consists only of the two validation scripts, mounted read-only. Provenance checks verify recorded artefact hashes and embedded source identity; load checks verify ELF format, dynamic linkage and the supported SUMMA version command. These checks contain no scientific case and do not establish numerical or forecasting validity.
source: Floodcast tests/integration/hydrology/check_model.py and validate_outputs.py, identified by the validation profile hashes.
license: Not separately specified; Floodcast project-authored validation code, with no third-party fixture data included.
expectations: Recorded model artefact hashes and full source revisions match the installed image
Compiled binaries are little-endian 64-bit ELF files and their dynamic libraries resolve
SUMMA supports its documented version command; no mizuRoute version flag is invented
A zero exit status applies only to the explicitly selected technical check
tolerance_rationale: These are exact identity, format and linkage checks. There are no numerical quantities or scientific tolerances in this technical fixture.
